# langchain-supabase-ingestor

> A production-grade system that ingests data from REST APIs, processes it with LangChain and local LLMs (Ollama), and fires intelligent in-app alerts using Supabase Realtime.

## Overview
This repository provides tools, frameworks, and implementations designed for:
- AI-driven applications, LLMs, and intelligent automation.
- Cross-platform development and deployment.
- Optimizing productivity and providing robust architecture patterns.
